claim_under_test: Four printable threshold gates fit beside a load-bearing 5.08 mm column
biggest_unproven_assumption: I1: four independent gates plus a ratchet plus 40 mm travel fit in one 5.08 mm cell with printable walls
cheapest_rejection_test: 2x5 full-pitch threshold strip with two independent mask layers and one common 10 mm stroke
key_dimensions: 5.08 mm pitch; 4.68 mm body; 0.40 mm max gap; 10 mm stroke
purchased_parts: force gauge; dial indicator; calibrated masses
measurement: missed steps; double steps; neighbour release; selection force
pass_threshold: zero missed/double steps on 500 adversarial cycles; neighbour shift <=0.10 mm; selection force < measured holding force / 3
fail_threshold: any missed/double step; any neighbour release; gate force window wider than 0.5x holding force
full_scale_assumption_tested: all 6400 cells are independent copies of this strip cell; masks scale to the full board
consequence_if_pass: S1 survives to a 10x10 tile coupon; mask writing becomes the next gate
consequence_if_fail: S1 rejected as a cell-density family; do not design a full tile

claim_under_test: An arbitrary mask can be written fast enough to meet the <30 s whole-map reveal
biggest_unproven_assumption: I2: a mask medium can be programmed off-board within the map-change interval
cheapest_rejection_test: Timed full mask-write path for one 10x10 tile, then extrapolate
key_dimensions: 10x10 cells = 50.8 x 50.8 mm tile; four unary threshold layers
purchased_parts: stopwatch; camera; writer fixture (if reusable shutters)
measurement: write time; install time; registration error; misreads
pass_threshold: <=4.0 s per tile end-to-end; <=5% misread; registration <=0.15 mm
fail_threshold: >8.0 s per tile or >15% misread or registration >0.4 mm
full_scale_assumption_tested: off-board programming is concurrent with play; 64 tiles prepared in a pipeline
consequence_if_pass: S1 mask path survives; proceed to shared-lift integration
consequence_if_fail: S1 can support only preplanned maps; regional reveal is weak

claim_under_test: Four stacked perforated/shutter planes register well enough for a small follower to read five heights
biggest_unproven_assumption: I3: multi-plane registration tolerance lets a 0.7 mm follower pass holes and stop on solid
cheapest_rejection_test: true-pitch 5x5 stack with four height plates plus floor; all five heights plus checkerboards
key_dimensions: 5.08 mm pitch; four planes; hole clearance sweep 0.05-0.25 mm per side; plate thickness 0.2-0.6 mm
printed_parts: four selector plates + bottom stop + 25 followers + support grid
purchased_parts: micrometer; height gauge; microscope; dial indicator
measurement: hole-edge catching; registration tolerance; plate deflection; supported load; repeat insertion
pass_threshold: all 25 cells seat within +/-0.25 mm; no edge catch in 100 insertions; 1 N static supported
fail_threshold: any edge catch in 100; height error >0.5 mm; plane deflection >0.25 mm under 1 N
repetitions_cycles: 100 insert/read cycles; all five heights; max adjacent height difference
full_scale_assumption_tested: registration/follower geometry is identical at 80x80; plate sag is bounded by the local support grid
consequence_if_pass: S2 survives to a 10x10 tile with a real writer
consequence_if_fail: S2 rejected as a planar-memory family; consider S4 only if the medium changes

claim_under_test: Planar memory tiles can be exchanged without moving an adjacent loaded tile or miniature
biggest_unproven_assumption: I4: tile swap disturbs the untouched neighbour by <0.10 mm
cheapest_rejection_test: J2 isolation rig (shared with Q5) at 5x5 and 10x10 boundaries
key_dimensions: two adjacent tiles; loaded neighbour held at mid-height; representative miniature on neighbour
printed_parts: two tiles + two media patterns + miniature base adapter
purchased_parts: dial indicator; 240 fps camera; representative miniature
measurement: peak vertical + lateral motion of untouched tile; miniature move/tip; insertion force; seam height
pass_threshold: untouched peak vertical <=0.10 mm and lateral <=0.10 mm; miniature does not move/tip; seam step <=0.25 mm
fail_threshold: peak >0.25 mm; miniature tips/moves >0.5 mm; seam >0.5 mm
full_scale_assumption_tested: tile isolation is a product requirement; boundary behaviour scales with tile size
consequence_if_pass: S2 regional updates survive; tile size selected
consequence_if_fail: S2 regional update rejected; full-board reset disclosed as a product weakness

claim_under_test: Hundreds of choices can be fanned out per station without hundreds of bought actuators
biggest_unproven_assumption: I5: a 2x4 printed selector register plus one shared drive completes a loaded dwell
cheapest_rejection_test: 2x4 full-pitch head section, one shared drive, adversarial checkerboard masks, loaded passive latches
key_dimensions: 5.08 mm pitch; four rows; short selector stroke (~1 mm) under a 40 mm shared stroke
purchased_parts: one small motor + driver for the shared drive; force gauge
measurement: complete engage/write/disengage dwell time; false selection; force; reset reliability
pass_threshold: loaded dwell <=0.60 s; zero false selections on all 256 binary masks; reset 100%
fail_threshold: dwell >1.0 s; any false selection or failed reset
repetitions_cycles: all 256 binary masks then mixed five-level maps; >=1000 cycles
full_scale_assumption_tested: one shared drive per station scales to 320-400 channels; selector cost <= $0.54 incl driver
consequence_if_pass: S3 survives to a larger head coupon; repriced BOM
consequence_if_fail: S3 rejected; shared-motion local-selection family narrowed

claim_under_test: Printable fan-out keeps bought selector cost under the $500 ceiling
biggest_unproven_assumption: I6: a complete selector + driver channel averages <= $0.54 (four-row) to preserve cost room
cheapest_rejection_test: quote + labour study: design one printed selector, obtain delivered quotes for its driver and shared drive
key_dimensions: selector and driver at 5.08 mm pitch and ~1 mm stroke
purchased_parts: one small motor + driver; matched delivered quotes for 320/400 channels
measurement: delivered unit price incl driver and amortised shared drive
full_scale_assumption_tested: cost scales linearly with channel count; no hidden per-cell part
consequence_if_pass: S3 cost gate passes; BOM under ceiling plausible
consequence_if_fail: the $500 ceiling is unreachable for this family; reject on cost

claim_under_test: A cheap tile clutch is truly independent under load
biggest_unproven_assumption: I7: a printed coupler engages one tile, leaves a loaded neighbour stationary, and no torque accumulates
cheapest_rejection_test: T3 shared-bus pair: two 2x4 tiles on one bus; cycle one while the other carries load
key_dimensions: two tiles on one common shaft/bus; loaded neighbour; forced-jam case
printed_parts: two tiles + clutch elements + bus coupler
purchased_parts: one shared motor + driver; force gauge; torque sensor
measurement: clutch torque; phase error vs bus length; neighbour displacement; jam propagation
pass_threshold: neighbour displacement <=0.10 mm; phase error bounded; jam contained to one tile; clutches engage synchronously
fail_threshold: neighbour state loss; phase error grows with bus; jam propagates; coupler > $6/channel
repetitions_cycles: cycle each tile until both together; then forced jam; >=500 cycles
full_scale_assumption_tested: 64 couplers scale from this pair; bus torsion is bounded
consequence_if_pass: S4 survives to a longer bus coupon

claim_under_test: One jam cannot corrupt a whole row or module
biggest_unproven_assumption: I8: failure containment is a real property, not an assumption
cheapest_rejection_test: inject a forced jam in one tile of the two-tile bus and measure neighbour state loss
measurement: jam propagation distance; neighbour state loss after jam
pass_threshold: jam remains inside one tile; no neighbour state change; READY false is detectable
fail_threshold: jam spreads to neighbour tile or is silent; READY stays true
repetitions_cycles: 10 forced jams at entry/middle/exit of bus
full_scale_assumption_tested: one jam's blast radius is a key product reliability gate
consequence_if_pass: S4 fault containment accepted; detection policy specified
consequence_if_fail: S4 rejected on reliability; correlated-fault risk confirmed

claim_under_test: An unloaded 3 mm printed stepped cam, guided follower and cheap 8 mm PM motor deliver reliable passive height memory at 5.08 mm pitch
biggest_unproven_assumption: Test09 U07/U08/U13: five-level toe margin, detent capture and 5 N toe load are unverified; ideal cam buckling is only ~4.96 N
cheapest_rejection_test: Test09 Stage A fit coupons, then Stage B passive six-cell full-pitch array
cells_or_units: 6 cells (3x2 passive array), then 30 batch sets
key_dimensions: 4.68 mm body; 5.08 mm pitch; 12.50 deg toe margin; 0.7x1.8 mm stem; 3 mm cam
printed_parts: passive rotor + follower + guide + lift plate + bearing halves
purchased_parts: elevation stage; dial indicator; force gauge; camera; load cell
measurement: drag vs weight; settled height per level; neighbour shift; 1 N/5 N load response
pass_threshold: drag+unc < 0.5x weight; height within +/-0.25 mm; neighbour shift <=0.10 mm; no crack/permanent set >0.25 mm; usable travel >=40 mm and > miniature
fail_threshold: persistent stick; height error >0.25 mm; neighbour release; any 5 N fracture
repetitions_cycles: 1000 then 10000 cycles/cell; 20 repeats per old/new level pair
full_scale_assumption_tested: Test08 geometry parameters are the production cell; Stage A printing process is representative
consequence_if_pass: S5 passive mechanism qualified; proceed to Stage C motor + detent
consequence_if_fail: S5 rejected as specified geometry; do not buy 80 motors or print 6400

claim_under_test: A loaded 8 mm PM motor sustains 400 pps and a replaceable detent corrects one 18 deg lost step
biggest_unproven_assumption: Test09 U08/U11/U15/U16: no loaded torque-speed curve; the historical detent only captures +/-8.72 deg
cheapest_rejection_test: Test09 Stage C one-motor bench with retained rotor and replaceable detent
key_dimensions: 3.3 V/40 ohm PM08-class motor; 22-step home; face coupling
purchased_parts: sample motor + dual bridge + current-limited supply + oscilloscope/current probe
measurement: rotor angle from optical fiducial; slip torque; restoring torque; capture from +/-6/9/18/24/30 deg
pass_threshold: seated angle+unc <=6 deg; captures +/-18 deg every time; loaded running torque >=0.15 mN m and >=2x mechanism torque; replay <=27 s
fail_threshold: fails to capture +/-18 deg; torque <2x mechanism; replay >=30 s
repetitions_cycles: 100 home/write cycles per 100-800 pps x 5 states; 10000 detent cycles
full_scale_assumption_tested: one motor channel is representative of all 80; timing replay scales
consequence_if_pass: S5 motor/detent gate passes; an 8-channel head is next

claim_under_test: Per-cell reliability can support a useful map at 6400 cells
biggest_unproven_assumption: I9: the independent per-cell error rate q is low and uncorrelated
cheapest_rejection_test: arithmetic plus the survivor's counted-failure coupon run
measurement: counted failures per 10000 operations per channel
pass_threshold: q such that P(perfect map) >= 0.99 -> q <= 1.57e-6; needs about 1.91e6 zero-failure trials
fail_threshold: demonstrating a six-cell coupon cannot bound q; any silent fault
full_scale_assumption_tested: independent-failure model is conservative; correlated faults only make it worse
consequence_if_pass: probability model accepted as a planning gate
consequence_if_fail: must add detection + bounded repair or tighten the mechanism

claim_under_test: The printed process keeps critical clearances across the board
biggest_unproven_assumption: I10: nominal clearance plus print/lot variation still passes the cell gate
cheapest_rejection_test: Stage A three-batch coupon batches at centre and corners of the bed
key_dimensions: critical clearance features at 5.08 mm pitch
measurement: clearance and web integrity across bed positions and lots
pass_threshold: all 30 sets interchangeable; no per-part sanding; measured clearance above minimum with stated sigma
fail_threshold: any part needs bespoke fitting; any missing web
full_scale_assumption_tested: process variation at coupon scale predicts board-scale variation; independence assumed
consequence_if_pass: process gate passes for that geometry

claim_under_test: Return and friction margin survives contamination and cycling
biggest_unproven_assumption: I11: modelled drag does not grow past the return margin in service
cheapest_rejection_test: contamination challenge: controlled sieved PLA dust then 100 cycles
measurement: breakaway/sliding force before/after; settle time; permanent set
pass_threshold: after clean+debris+clean: drag still < 0.5x weight; settle <=0.4 s
fail_threshold: any persistent stick or drag >= weight
repetitions_cycles: 100 cycles per dust load; 10000 baseline cycles
full_scale_assumption_tested: dust/wear behaviour at one cell predicts the board
consequence_if_fail: positive return or cleaning architecture required

claim_under_test: Regional updates meet a proportional time budget at tile size
biggest_unproven_assumption: I12: tile disturbance and update time scale with the region, not the full board
cheapest_rejection_test: J2 isolation rig timed on a 10x10 and 20x20 boundary
pass_threshold: regional clear+settle time <= fixed overhead + fraction of full-map time; neighbour disturbance within limits
fail_threshold: regional time >= full-map time; neighbour disturbance over limit
full_scale_assumption_tested: regional update is a product requirement and discriminates S1/S2/S4
consequence_if_pass: tile size and update policy selected
consequence_if_fail: architecture requires full-board reset per reveal; product weakness recorded
